title: Perceptual presence needs counterfactually rich models

statements.text: Objects feel really there when the generative model encodes rich counterfactual predictions about how sensory input would change under possible actions, even actions not taken.

sources.quote: perceptual presence is underpinned by the engagement of counterfactually-rich HGMs within the framework of PP.
incorporate explicitly counterfactual elements related to how sensory inputs would change on the basis of a broad repertoire of possible actions, even if those actions are not performed.
